zh_title: 周末晴暖有风，最高约 80°F
zh_points: 周末晴朗、偏暖、有风，最高气温华氏 70 多度到 80 出头（约 25–28°C），持续到周一，之后回落到正常水平。
en_points: Sunny, warm and breezy weekend: highs in the upper 70s to low 80s through Monday, then temperatures cool back to near normal.

title: Sunshine and Unseasonable Warmth This Weekend
zh_title: 周末异常暖和，周一晚起有雷雨
zh_points: 周六最高 80 多°F（约 27–29°C），部分地区或接近纪录；周一晚到周二有雨和雷暴，之后转凉多雨，下周出门带伞。
en_points: Highs in the low to mid-80s Saturday, possibly near records; rain and storms return Monday evening into Tuesday, then a cooler week with more rain chances.

title: 84-year-old woman dead after vehicle falls from parking garage
zh_title: 檀香山 84 岁老人驾车坠出停车楼身亡
zh_points: 檀香山市中心一辆车撞破停车楼五楼护墙后坠落，84 岁女司机身亡；外州新闻，与校园无关。
en_points: An 84-year-old woman died after her car broke through a fifth-floor retaining wall at a downtown Honolulu parking garage and fell to the sidewalk.
